_note: Convention from OutputBox/COSTING/ (flat, no dated subfolders): '{Vendor} -  {InvoiceNumber}.pdf'. The separator is space-hyphen-SPACE-SPACE, and vendor casing is not normalised in the live data. The invoice number is the KEY: it is labelled and survives OCR. The vendor is LOOKED UP from the invoice prefix (src/config/lookups/vendors.json) rather than read off the page, because the page carries several company names with no consistent label -- the buyer's own name, sometimes a different manufacturer, sometimes a bank -- and the existing filenames spell the same legal form eleven different ways. A prefix absent from the map falls through to reading the vendor from the document, which is how LAYLO LLC resolves (bare-digit invoice numbers, but a VENDOR label on the page). Documents that carry neither -- their invoice number is not in the text at all -- flag as MissingFields.

vendorName._note: Looked up from the invoice prefix; patterns are the fallback for a prefix the map does not know. Each pattern anchors on a legal-form suffix (LLC/LTD/LIMITED/INC/...) rather than a whitespace run, because OCR splits names with multiple spaces ('VENDOR  LAYLO   LLC') and a whitespace terminator would truncate to 'LAYLO'. The letterhead is deliberately NOT a pattern: it is the worst-OCR region of the page and indistinguishable from the buyer's name.
